data.name: Muqtafi
data.gender_notes: Muqtafi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who selects and decides for others. A judge, arbitrator, or leader. The name Muqtafi carries the meaning “Chooser, Arbiter, Decider, Judge” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Muqtafi usually hope their child will grow to embody chooser, arbiter, decider, judge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of discernment and the ability to make wise decisions based on spiritual guidance.
data.etymology: Muqtafi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Chooser, Arbiter, Decider, Judge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muqtafi total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: مقتفي
in_arabic.meaning: الذي يأخذ و ينتقم من الظالمين و يمنع الظلم
in_arabic.long_meaning: مقتفي هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، ويعني الذي يأخذ و ينتقم من الظالمين و يمنع الظلم، وهو من الأسماء التي تعبر عن قدرة الله تعالى على الإنقاذ و الانتقام. ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة آيات، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَالِمٍ لِّعِبَادِهِ' (سورة مريم: ١٧٥). يعتبر اسم مقتفي من الأسماء ذات الأهمية الكبيرة في الإسلام، حيث يرمز إلى العدالة الإلهية و الإنصاف.

in_urdu.name: مقتفی
in_urdu.meaning: جو ظالموں سے انتقام لیتا ہے اور ظلم کو روکتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مقتفی ایک خوبصورت نام ہے جو اللہ کے صفاتی ناموں میں سے ایک ہے۔ یہ نام اسی معنی میں استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو ظالموں کو سزا دیتا ہے اور ظلم کو مٹاتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اردو میں بھی اسی معنی میں استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقویم میں اس نام کی اہمیت بہت زیادہ ہے کیونکہ یہ نام اللہ کی عدل و انصاف کی یاد دلاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुक़तफ़ि
in_hindi.meaning: जो लोग अन्याय करते हैं उनसे प्रतिशोध लेता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुक़तफ़ि एक सुंदर नाम है जो अल्लाह के विशेष नामों में से एक है। यह नाम उन लोगों के लिए उपयोग होता है जो अल्लाह की विशेषता को दर्शाता है जो अन्यायियों को दंड देता है और अन्याय को समाप्त करता है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और हिंदी में भी इसी अर्थ में उपयोग होता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में इस नाम का बहुत महत्व है क्योंकि यह नाम अल्लाह की न्याय और निष्पक्षता की याद दिलाता है।

in_pashto.name: مقتفي
in_pashto.meaning: چې د ظالمينو څخه يې انتقام اخلي
in_pashto.long_meaning: مقتفي د الله تعالی يو نوم دی، چې معنی يې د ظالمينو څخه انتقام اخلي او د ظلم مخه يې نيسي. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی دی او د پښتو ژبې په همدې معني استعمال کيږي. په اسلامي ميراث کې دا نوم ډير اهميت لري، ځکه چې دا نوم د الله تعالی د عدل او انصاف يادونه کوي.

in_english.name: Muqtafi
in_english.meaning: One who takes revenge from the oppressors and prevents oppression
in_english.long_meaning: Muqtafi is one of the beautiful names of Allah, meaning one who takes revenge from the oppressors and prevents oppression. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'q-t-f' which means 'to follow' or 'to take'. In the Quran, Allah is described as Al-Muqtafi in several verses, including Surah Maryam: 175. This name signifies Allah's power to take revenge from the oppressors and to protect the oppressed. It is an important name in Islamic tradition, symbolizing Allah's justice and fairness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Muqtafi reflects the historical context of the Islamic Golden Age where scholars and leaders were the primary sources of knowledge, guidance, and governance. Muqtafis played a significant role in society as they were entrusted with the responsibility of interpreting and applying Islamic law, as well as making critical decisions for the betterment of their communities. Their knowledge, wisdom, and judgement were valued and respected, which added to the cultural significance of the name.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Muqtafi holds spiritual significance due to its association with wisdom, judgment, and leadership. It symbolizes the ability to make wise decisions based on knowledge and understanding, and to use this knowledge for the greater good. It also emphasizes the importance of humility, as a Muqtafi is not only responsible for the decisions they make, but also for the impact of those decisions on the lives of others. In a spiritual sense, the name Muqtafi serves as a reminder of the responsibility we have towards others and the importance of making decisions that align with Islamic values and principles.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Chooser, Arbiter, Decider, Judge" symbolizes One who selects and decides for others. A judge, arbitrator, or leader.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Muqtafi serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of chooser, arbiter, decider, judge.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Muqtafi was a title given to the Abbasid Caliphs, meaning 'the supported one'. The name Muqtafi carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Muqtafi was a title given to the Abbasid Caliphs, who ruled the Islamic Empire from Baghdad. The title signified that the caliph was supported by the military and the people.
